composition.reason: A student sees it’s raining, realizes he needs an umbrella, and thinks he should ask a classmate to borrow one.

judgeLog.raw:
PLAN A: CAUSAL 9 CHRONOLOGY 9 PLAUSIBILITY 7 SIMPLICITY 10 TARGETFIT 9 SUITABILITY 9 CONTRADICTION no OVERALL 8 — Strong structure and natural language targets; sink resolves easily without a drain cleaner, reducing dramatic tension/realism slightly.
PLAN B: CAUSAL 6 CHRONOLOGY 5 PLAUSIBILITY 6 SIMPLICITY 9 TARGETFIT 5 SUITABILITY 7 CONTRADICTION yes OVERALL 5 — Teleports between rooms; conditional '如果' is forced; "no flour" premise contradicts the title concept logic.
PLAN C: CAUSAL 8 CHRONOLOGY 7 PLAUSIBILITY 5 SIMPLICITY 9 TARGETFIT 7 SUITABILITY 7 CONTRADICTION yes OVERALL 5 — Unclear how wet shoes appear in a car; conditional '如果' usage is weak despite setup.
PLAN D: CAUSAL 8 CHRONOLOGY 9 PLAUSIBILITY 9 SIMPLICITY 8 TARGETFIT 7 SUITABILITY 9 CONTRADICTION no OVERALL 7 — Solid everyday logic; HSK vocabulary fits, though "what should we do" is a bit repetitive for '该' targeting.

PLAN E: CAUSAL 10 CHRONOLOGY 10 PLAUSIBILITY 10 SIMPLICITY 10 TARGETFIT 9 SUITABILITY 10 CONTRADICTION no OVERALL 9 — Extremely tight logic, natural flow, and perfect HSK 3 vocabulary integration.
PLAN F: CAUSAL 8 CHRONOLOGY 10 PLAUSIBILITY 4 SIMPLICITY 10 TARGETFIT 6 SUITABILITY 7 CONTRADICTION no OVERALL 6 — Awkward dialogue ("how should I say") breaks realism; target words feel forced into unnatural contexts.
PLAN G: CAUSAL 7 CHRONOLOGY 10 PLAUSIBILITY 8 SIMPLICITY 9 TARGETFIT 5 SUITABILITY 8 CONTRADICTION no OVERALL 6 — Target words (especially 认为/该) are shoehorned into internal thoughts rather than natural speech acts, reducing pedagogical value.
PLAN H: CAUSAL 9 CHRONOLOGY 10 PLAUSIBILITY 9 SIMPLICITY 10 TARGETFIT 8 SUITABILITY 9 CONTRADICTION yes OVERALL 8 — Strong plot but contradicts the target word list (missing 该 in beats, mentioned only in notes as an afterthought).

PLAN I: CAUSAL 10 CHRONOLOGY 10 PLAUSIBILITY 10 SIMPLICITY 10 TARGETFIT 10 SUITABILITY 10 CONTRADICTION no OVERALL 10 — Flawless cause-and-effect, perfect for HSK 3 scope and target words.
PLAN J: CAUSAL 6 CHRONOLOGY 8 PLAUSIBILITY 10 SIMPLICITY 7 TARGETFIT 5 SUITABILITY 8 CONTRADICTION no OVERALL 6 — Weak causality; rain warning is irrelevant to getting the charger, resolving the problem too early.
PLAN K: CAUSAL 4 CHRONOLOGY 9 PLAUSIBILITY 5 SIMPLICITY 9 TARGETFIT 6 SUITABILITY 7 CONTRADICTION no OVERALL 5 — Broken logic in Beat 2 (thinking vs. doing) and implausible self-repair of a lock with just a screwdriver.
PLAN L: CAUSAL 9 CHRONOLOGY 10 PLAUSIBILITY 6 SIMPLICITY 8 TARGETFIT 8 SUITABILITY 9 CONTRADICTION no OVERALL 8 — Strong plot, though a loaner laptop is slightly lucky/convenient for a simple story, it works well pedagogically.

PLAN M: CAUSAL 6 CHRONOLOGY 4 PLAUSIBILITY 7 SIMPLICITY 9 TARGETFIT 8 SUITABILITY 8 CONTRADICTION yes OVERALL 5 — Internal logic contradiction in Beat 5 destination (changes location to hallway immediately after charging in classroom) breaks chronology and causes issues.
PLAN N: CAUSAL 8 CHRONOLOGY 7 PLAUSIBILITY 4 SIMPLICITY 6 TARGETFIT 7 SUITABILITY 3 CONTRADICTION no OVERALL 4 — Low plausibility (qipao for male character) and cultural mismatch for standard HSK3 reader; complex ironing subplot adds unnecessary friction.
PLAN O: CAUSAL 8 CHRONOLOGY 8 PLAUSIBILITY 9 SIMPLICITY 9 TARGETFIT 9 SUITABILITY 9 CONTRADICTION no OVERALL 9 — Strong causal chain, perfect target word integration, high plausibility, and fits HSK3 constraints with no logical flaws.

blueprint.title: The Rain and The Book
blueprint.setting: A university campus library and the sidewalk outside during a sudden afternoon thunderstorm.
blueprint.problem: 李明 realizes it is raining heavily and he does not have an umbrella, but he wants to meet 小红.
blueprint.incitingEvent: Look out the window and see heavy rain falling on the campus.

beats.what: 李明 puts down his book and looks out the large window next to his desk. He sees heavy rain hitting the glass and the ground below.
beats.because: the story opens
beats.where: Inside the university library study room

beats.what: 李明 touches his bag and realizes he has no umbrella. He thinks about his plan to go home. He decides he cannot walk in this rain.
beats.because: the heavy rain prevents him from leaving without getting wet
beats.where: Inside the university library study room

beats.what: 李明 sees 小红 sitting at the next table. He remembers that 小红 has a big yellow umbrella in her bag. He gets an idea for a solution.
beats.because: he needs an umbrella and sees a classmate who has one
beats.where: Inside the university library study room

beats.what: 李明 walks over to 小红's table. He asks 小红 if he can borrow her umbrella for a short time because he forgot his own.
beats.because: he identified 小红 as the person who can help him
beats.where: Inside the university library study room

beats.what: 小红 looks at her book, then smiles and gives the yellow umbrella to 李明. She says she will wait for the rain to stop inside.
beats.because: 李明 asked politely and 小红 is a good friend
beats.where: Inside the university library study room

blueprint.resolution: 李明 successfully borrows the umbrella and is able to leave the library without getting wet, resolving his problem of how to get through the rain.

blueprint.title: The Heavy Quilt
blueprint.setting: A cold winter afternoon in a shared apartment bedroom.
blueprint.problem: 李明's bed is empty and cold because the heavy quilt is missing; he needs to find it to sleep.
blueprint.incitingEvent: 李明 returns from school, takes off his coat, and touches his bed, realizing the 被 is gone.

beats.what: 李明 enters his room. He opens his wardrobe and takes out his pajamas. He looks at the bed and is surprised.
beats.because: the story opens

beats.what: 李明 looks around the room. He checks under the bed. There is no 被. He is cold and tired.
beats.because: He needs a 被 to sleep, but it is not on the bed.

beats.what: 李明 walks out of his room. He stands in front of 小红's door. He thinks about knocking.
beats.because: He suspects 小红 might have taken the 被 by mistake.
beats.arrivedHow: 李明 walks from his bedroom to the hallway.

beats.what: 李明 knocks. 小红 opens the door. 李明 asks about the 被.
beats.because: He needs to confirm if 小红 has the 被.
beats.arrivedHow: 李明 knocks on 小红's door and enters.

beats.what: 小红 points to the corner. The 被 is there. She explains she borrowed it last week and forgot. She says she 该 give it back.
beats.because: He found the 被.

blueprint.resolution: 小红 gives the 被 back to 李明. 李明 is happy and goes to sleep.

blueprint.title: The Heavy Book
blueprint.setting: A university library and a bus stop on a Friday afternoon.
blueprint.problem: 李明 needs to transport many heavy reference books to the bus stop, but he only has one small backpack.
blueprint.incitingEvent: 李明 finds that his backpack is too small and too weak to hold three large dictionaries.

beats.what: 李明 is packing three large Chinese dictionaries into a small backpack. The zipper breaks because the books are too heavy.
beats.because: the story opens

beats.what: 李明 looks around for help. He sees 小红 sitting nearby with a large, empty shopping bag next to her chair.
beats.because: 李明 cannot carry all the books himself and needs a bigger container.

beats.what: 李明 walks over to 小红’s desk. He explains his problem and asks if he can use her bag.
beats.because: 李明 identified 小红 as a potential helper with a suitable object.

beats.what: 小红 thinks about the request. She decides that it is good to help a classmate. She agrees.
beats.because: 李明 made a polite request.

beats.what: 李明 thanks 小红. They wait for the bus together outside.
beats.because: The books are now packaged safely, and they need to leave the campus.
beats.arrivedHow: 李明 and 小红 walk out of the library gates to the bus stop.

blueprint.resolution: 李明 successfully boards the bus with his books, having used 小红’s bag as a temporary solution.

blueprint.title: The Full Sink
blueprint.setting: Sunday morning, 小明's apartment kitchen
blueprint.problem: The kitchen sink is clogged and overflowing with soapy water; 小明 needs to clean it but does not know how.
blueprint.incitingEvent: 小明 tries to wash a bowl, but the water level rises instead of draining.

beats.what: 小明 stands at the sink washing a blue bowl. The water stops draining and begins to overflow onto the counter.
beats.because: the story opens

beats.what: 小明 turns off the tap. He looks at the dirty water and thinks he **needs** a tool to fix the drain, but he only has his hands and a sponge.
beats.because: the overflow creates an immediate problem that requires a solution

beats.what: 小明 walks out of the kitchen into the living room. He sees 妈妈 sitting on the sofa reading a book. He asks her for help.
beats.because: 小明 cannot solve the problem alone and must seek assistance
beats.arrivedHow: 小明 walks from the kitchen to the living room

beats.what: 妈妈 closes her book. She **believes** that 小明 should handle small household problems by himself to learn. She tells him what he **should** do.
beats.because: 小明 asked for help, prompting 妈妈 to evaluate the situation and respond

beats.what: 小明 returns to the sink. He starts the tap again. He says, **if** the water flows, he will cook dinner; **if** not, he will call the repairman. The water drains quickly.
beats.because: 妈妈's advice caused 小明 to try the simple fix first before calling for professional help
beats.arrivedHow: 小明 walks from the living room back to the kitchen

beats.what: The sink is empty and clean. 小明 smiles and waves at 妈妈 in the living room. The problem is solved without calling anyone.
beats.because: the test in the previous beat was successful, resolving the central problem

blueprint.resolution: The sink drains successfully after 小明 follows the implicit advice to try restarting the flow, proving he did not need a repairman.
